## loadHostGovernance() function

Load the governance context this Mac enforces.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function loadHostGovernance(options?: LoadHostGovernanceOptions): Promise<GovernanceContext>
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[GovernanceContext](./runtime.governancecontext.md)<!-- -->&gt;

The governance context, with approvals only when a provider is registered.

## Exceptions

`ActivePolicyError` when the policy file is malformed, `ApprovalProviderError` when the approval registration is malformed or its provider cannot be loaded, and the underlying filesystem error when either file exists but cannot be read.

## Remarks

Composes the active host policy, the approval gate when one is registered, the stored per-key policy resolver, and a file audit writer. A missing policy file yields the default policy; a malformed or unreadable policy file or approval registration rejects. Pass the function itself as a runtime's `governance` so it is loaded on first use: `createRuntime({ executor, governance: loadHostGovernance })`<!-- -->.
